  • Ensure clusters and workloads meet cybersecurity, data privacy, and lifecycle compliance requirements.
  • Support audits and remediate non‑compliant configurations.
  • Drive the transition from CentOS to supported and approved OS platforms.

Automation, Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Automate repetitive operational tasks, cluster provisioning, workload deployment, configuration, and compliance enforcement.
  • Contribute to product roadmaps, automation frameworks, and standard reference designs.
  • Participate in EPIC initiatives to reduce complexity and increase efficiency.
  • Assist with PPDM migrations for Kubernetes‑based backup workloads.
  • Contribute to patch testing frameworks using canary/ring deployment models.

Platform 3 / CCOE Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with CCOE intake, design, and fulfillment teams to deliver frictionless onboarding.
  • Ensure Kubernetes solutions align with lifecycle, security, and platform standards.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions to extend platform knowledge across Cox.
  • Participate in customer feedback loops, roadshows, and product management routines.
  • Provide timely support for Rancher migrations and eventual decommissioning.

AI & GPU Platform Support

  • Support deployment of GPU‑enabled Kubernetes clusters.
  • Implement automation for provisioning GPU workloads.
  • Validate ServiceNow intake workflows for AI-native tenant designs.

Observability, Reporting & KPIs

  • Enhance New Relic dashboards for Kubernetes reliability and health.
  • Develop and publish right-sizing audit reports for cluster optimization and cost efficiency.
  • Track cluster capacity, growth, and licensing/tool usage.
  • Participate in monthly operational reviews.

title: Coordenador (a) Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Coordenar as atividades de planejamento regulatório, garantindo a gestão estratégica dos contratos, a análise de impactos regulatórios e a interface com stakeholders internos e externos, com foco na sustentabilidade econômico-financeira da operação.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a equipe de planejamento regulatório.
  • Supervisionar análises de fluxo de caixa, indicadores contratuais e impactos regulatórios.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor com Jurídico, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e consultorias externas.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas a reequilíbrios contratuais, investimentos e pleitos.
  • Garantir governança, qualidade técnica e consistência das informações apresentadas.
  • Atuar fortemente na gestão com visão integrada do contrato.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento regulatório, concessões, PPPs ou gestão de contratos complexos.
  • Forte domínio de análises econômico-financeiras e visão estratégica.
  • Capacidade de liderança, coordenação e desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Perfil analítico, com boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação com múltiplos stakeholders.


Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

  • rastreabilidade dos projetos, conforme metodologia estabelecida pelo Escritório de Projetos (PMO);

title: Solutions Architect

Are you a visionary architect who lives at the intersection of Data and Infrastructure ? We are looking for a heavy-hitter to lead massive, high-stakes cloud migrations for some of the world’s largest brands in Banking, Healthcare, and Insurance.

As our SQL Architect , you aren't just moving databases; you are reimagining how global enterprises operate in the cloud. You will be the technical authority responsible for auditing complex legacy environments and architecting the future-state of Azure Data & Infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect the Future: Conduct deep-dive \"AS-IS\" assessments and design sophisticated \"Target State\" architectures that get approved by executive review boards.

  • Be the Expert: Provide technical leadership in troubleshooting deep-stack issues (Networking, IO, Clusters) and define the BoM (Bill of Materials) to ensure clients get maximum value for their investment.

What We’re Looking For

  • The Veteran: 15+ years of IT experience, with at least a decade dedicated to the Microsoft Azure ecosystem.
  • The SQL Specialist: Deep, hands-on mastery of Azure SQL (IaaS & PaaS) , Azure Storage, and high-availability data solutions.
  • The Strategist: Experience in Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery (BCDR) and infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • The Communicator: Ability to bridge the gap between deep technical troubleshooting and C-suite stakeholder management.
  • The Industry Expert: Previous success navigating the regulatory complexities of the Banking or Healthcare sectors.

Technical Toolkit

  • Primary: Azure SQL, Azure Migrate, IAM, Key Vault, Storage.
  • Architecture: Mastery of Frameworks (TOGAF or similar), HLD/LLD creation.
  • Certification (The Cherry on Top): AZ-305 (Infrastructure Solutions) or AZ-104 (Administrator).

Why Join Us?

You will work on projects of massive scale where your designs directly impact the security and efficiency of global financial and medical data. This is a role for an architect who wants to own the \"Big Picture\" while staying sharp on the technical details.

Ready to build the next generation of Cloud Infrastructure? Let’s talk.

We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.

title: AI Video Ad Creator +  Copywriter + Visual Asset Designer
description:
The opportunity


We’re building a high-output creative engine for paid ads-and we’re looking for a specialist who can write the words that sell and turn them into scroll-stopping short-form video ads using AI video tools, strong editing, and performance thinking.


This is not a “make pretty videos” role. This is concept → copy → creative → iterations → winners .

If you live at the intersection of genAI + storytelling + conversion copywriting , this role is for you.


You’ll create AI-driven video ads and visual assets for campaigns across TikTok, Instagram Reels/Stories, YouTube Shorts, Meta, and more. We optimize for ROAS, CTR, CVR, hook rate, hold rate, and retention -and the copywriting is a core lever in every asset we ship.


What you’ll do


You own the creative from message to motion-including the copywriting .

Copywriting + creative strategy

  • Write conversion-focused short-form scripts (15-45s) : hooks, problem framing, proof, offer, CTA.
  • Create multiple copy angles per concept (pain-based, benefit-based, curiosity, contrarian, founder POV, social proof, demo-driven).
  • Write and version hook lines, VO scripts, on-screen text, captions, headlines, end-card CTAs , and thumbnail copy.
  • Translate product benefits into clear, punchy, platform-native messaging (no fluff, no generic AI-sounding copy).
  • Apply direct-response frameworks (Problem → Agitation → Solution, Before/After, Myth-busting, Objection handling, etc.) with modern pacing.

Video production + asset creation

  • Produce short-form ad creatives designed for conversion (tight cuts, retention-first pacing, pattern interrupts).
  • Create AI-generated video sequences and combine them with real footage/UGC where needed.
  • Generate visual assets for ad variations: thumbnails, product scenes, backgrounds, overlays, cutdowns, motion graphics, end cards.
  • Build multiple versions of the same concept (different hooks, copy angles, pacing, captions, VO, formats).
  • Work from a brief and deliver fast iterations based on performance feedback.
  • Maintain brand consistency while still pushing creative boundaries.
  • Collaborate with growth/marketing to align creative with testing strategy and learnings.


Minimum requirements (non-negotiable)


To be considered, you must meet the requirements below and include proof in your application:

  • Resume must be written in English.
  • You must share examples of your AI video ad work with VO and Dialogue (not just AI visuals).
  • Copywriting is required: you must provide evidence you wrote/owned the scripts and ad copy for at least some of the work you share (scripts, hook lists, on-screen text, captions, or a short case study describing your role).
  • You must provide at least ONE of the following:
  • Evidence you produced creatives that generated strong ROAS / conversion lift (screenshots, case study, or summary metrics), OR
  • A video you produced that achieved 10,000+ views , OR
  • Proof you can create complex AI short-form ad videos (not basic slideshow edits-think narrative, scene continuity, ad pacing, multiple AI shots, strong compositing).
  • You have managed or been part of a social media account with 10,000+ followers .


What “qualified” looks like (skills we’re actively looking for)


You don’t just edit-you communicate and convert.

  • You understand what makes a video ad perform: thumb-stopping hooks, clear messaging, pattern interrupts, pacing, proof, offer structure, CTA clarity .
  • You can write direct-response copy that sounds human, specific, and brand-right-not generic “AI marketing” language.
  • You can create AI-driven visuals that look intentional and brand-ready (not uncanny or generic).
  • You can edit like a performance creator: tight cuts, retention-first pacing, captions, kinetic typography, sound design.
  • You have a repeatable workflow to deliver high volume with high quality (and keep assets organized).


Tools & workflows (use what you’re best at)


We’re tool-agnostic, but you should be highly capable with several of the following:

AI + creative

  • AI video generation (e.g., Runway, Pika, or comparable tools)
  • AI image generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, etc.)
  • Voice & audio (AI voiceover tools, sound design, music selection, cleanup)

Editing + delivery

  • Editing & motion (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Creative versioning + organized file delivery (naming conventions, aspect ratios, exports)

Copywriting workflow (important)

  • You can work quickly in tools like Docs/Notion , and you know how to build:
  • Hook banks
  • Script variations
  • Angle matrices
  • Offer/CTA libraries
  • Caption + primary text variants aligned to the video


Deliverables & expectations


Typical output: 10 ad creatives per month (depending on campaign cycle), plus variations.

Format mastery: 9:16 primary , plus 1:1 and 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

You can deliver:

  • Final exports (platform-ready)
  • Project files when requested
  • Source assets used (AI outputs, overlays, audio references)

Copy deliverables (required):

  • Script + VO text (or structured script outline)
  • Hook variations (often 5-15 per concept)
  • On-screen text + caption plan (what appears when, and why)
  • End card copy + CTA variants
  • Optional: primary text/caption variants for Meta/TikTok where needed

Turnaround: fast iteration is key (often 24-72 hours per revision cycle , depending on scope).


How we evaluate success


  • Your creatives clearly map to an angle + message and drive action.
  • Iterations improve performance (hooks improve, retention improves, CTR/CVR improves).
  • Your output is consistent, organized, and easy to test at scale.
  • Your copy + editing work together (the words and visuals reinforce the same conversion story).

﻿

Compensation


Competitive and flexible based on experience and proof of performance.

Per project bases

If you’re a performance-minded AI creative who can write high-converting scripts and ship high-quality ads fast -and you have proof-apply with the items above.

Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura invisível que conecta o físico ao digital com precisão, propósito e impacto real.

  • Experiência prática com Kubernetes (Digital Ocean ou qualquer cloud), Docker, CI/CD e GitOps (ArgoCD ou similar)
  • Já criou ou manteve pipelines de deploy automatizados (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)
  • Conforto com scripts (bash, TypeScript ou Python) e infra as code (Helm, Terraform/Pulumi é diferencial)

  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe – vai interagir muito com backend, dados e o DevOps Sênior

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.

title: Global Process Data Consultant | SAP S/4HANA | OTC & MTO | Data Migration & Governance
description:
Position Purpose

undertaking multiple large-scale global transformation initiatives , including a greenfield SAP S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC, MTO).

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant/Lead to support data conversion, migration, governance, and ongoing data management . This role is critical in ensuring business data is fit-for-purpose, standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build, migration, and user adoption.

The consultant will act as a bridge between business process owners, SAP functional teams, and the data enablement organization , embedding data requirements into solution design and execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements aligned with standardized value stream processes
  • Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data definitions for SAP S/4HANA
  • Support global template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies across geographies
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return)

2. Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards

3. Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation cycles
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover

4. Data Governance & Standards

  • Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies
  • Collaborate closely with Master Data Management and Data Governance teams
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes

5. Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy and completeness
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and newly created data
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization during hypercare

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with a strong focus on data
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred)
  • Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations
  • Strong understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects
  • Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects, including:
  • Material Master
  • Customer / Business Partner
  • Vendor
  • BOMs
  • Routings
  • Pricing
  • Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC
  • Experience with SAP MDG or similar data governance tools (preferred)
  • Familiarity with data migration tools such as SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, or ETL tools
  • Ability to interpret functional specifications and data models

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries
  • Prior experience as a Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models
  • Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics

title: Senior Dynamics GP Administrator
description:
Job Title:- Senior Dynamics GP Administrator

Experience:- 5+Years

Location :- Remote/Hybrid (Canada/Mexico/US/Brazil)


Role summary

Seeking a Senior Dynamics GP Administrator to own day-to-day operations of Microsoft Dynamics GP and related integrations, support ongoing configuration and customization, and partner with stakeholders on planning and executing an upgrade/migration to Dynamics 365 Business Central. This is a hands-on production support role with accountability for stability, performance, change control, and documentation.


Key responsibilities

Daily Operations & Support

  • Administer and support Dynamics GP environments (production and non-prod): user/security management, company setups, batch processing, month-end close support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor system health and performance; coordinate with infrastructure/DBA teams on backups, restores, refreshes, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Manage support tickets, root-cause analysis, and preventive fixes; communicate status to business and IT stakeholders.


Configuration & Customizations

  • Maintain and support GP configuration (financials, purchasing, inventory, etc., as applicable) including setups, posting processes, and workflows.
  • Support and coordinate customizations (modified forms/reports, SSRS, SmartLists, VBA/Dexterity add-ons, third-party ISVs), including testing and deployment across environments.
  • Maintain change control: release notes, regression testing, and documentation of functional and technical changes.


Integrations & Data

  • Own operational support for integrations into/out of GP (eConnect, SSIS, SmartConnect/Scribe/other middleware, file-based imports/exports, API/EDI as applicable).
  • Troubleshoot integration failures, reconcile data issues, and coordinate enhancements with developers and vendors.


Business Central Upgrade / Migration Assistance

  • Support discovery and readiness activities for GP → Dynamics 365 Business Central migration: inventory configuration/customizations, integration mapping, data migration scoping, and cutover planning support.
  • Assist with UAT coordination, defect triage, and transition planning (process changes, training inputs, documentation updates).


Documentation

  • Produce and maintain operational runbooks and environment documentation (security, integrations, job schedules, close procedures, troubleshooting guides).
  • Create a customization and integration register to support modernization and migration planning.


Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Dynamics GP administration/support in production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of GP security, posting/batch processes, and month-end close support.
  • Experience supporting GP customizations and reporting (modified forms/reports, SSRS/SmartList Builder, third-party add-ons).
  • Integration support experience (eConnect and/or middleware such as SmartConnect, Scribe, SSIS; troubleshooting data movement and reconciliation).
  • Solid SQL Server skills (reading/writing queries for troubleshooting, understanding GP databases, jobs, and performance basics).
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working in a ticketed support model.


Preferred qualifications

  • Prior involvement in GP → Business Central migration/upgrade projects (discovery, fit-gap, testing, cutover).

  • Capacidade de identificar interações de usuário baseadas na web e desenvolver componentes de interface de usuário altamente responsivos .

b. Experiência prática na integração de modelos e frameworks de IA em ambientes de produção.

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.


Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Video editor
description:
We are…
A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.You Are...
An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team
You Will...
Edit audio and video for podcast, You Tube videos, advertisments, branded content, and moreto create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, You Tube, Tik Tok).
Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
and more...Job Requirements
You Have...
The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Business developer for social media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.Key Responsibilities:
Identify high-revenue potential You Tube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic prioritiesIdeal Candidate Profile:
Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainmentIf you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!Please upload your updated CV in English!

title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market –how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality :At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving :We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.

Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.

Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.

title: Devops engineer
description:
Important Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob Summary
As a Dev Ops Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The Dev Ops engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teamsResponsibilities and Duties
Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions;
Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.Essential Skills
Experience in a Dev Ops role, with hands-on AWS experience;
Experience with Ia C tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Circle CI and Github Actions;
Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).Highly Desirable Skills
Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, Cloud Watch;
Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.Responsibilities
• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.
• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.
• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.
• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.
• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Tax coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.
The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.
RESPONSABILITIES
i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.
ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.
iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.
iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.
v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.
vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.
vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M& A transactions.
viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.
ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.
QUALIFICATIONS
i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area
ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)
iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.
ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.
iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable
SOFT SKILLS
i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
ii. Effective planning and priority setting
iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented
iv. Teamwork
v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication
vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills
vii. Analytical skills

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .
Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.
Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.
Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.
Principais Responsabilidades
Consolidar e analisar indicadores contratuais e regulatórios.
Construir, atualizar e acompanhar modelos de fluxo de caixa e demonstrativos de resultado.
Avaliar impactos de eventos contratuais como reequilíbrios, pleitos, investimentos antecipados ou postergações.
Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas Jurídica, Regulatório, Planejamento Interno e stakeholders externos.
Apoiar análises de teses jurídicas sob a ótica econômico-financeira.
Garantir a manutenção do equilíbrio econômico-financeiro dos contratos.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em planejamento financeiro, concessões, PPPs ou contratos de longo prazo.
Domínio de modelagem econômico-financeira, fluxo de caixa e DRE.
Vivência em ambientes regulados será um diferencial.
Benefícios:
Assistência médica;

Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.
Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.
Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Job Description
About You
You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.
You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (Py Spark is a strong plus).
Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Postgre SQL, or similar.
Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
(If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.
Additional Information
Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.
Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!
We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

title: Platform engineer (aws)
description:
About you
You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning. Hands-on experience with Git Hub , Git Hub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation. Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage . Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (Paa S) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows. Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning. Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs. Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services. Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale. Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs. Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation. Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams. Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.

title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Estilista especialista
description:
O Especialista Estilista é o mentor criativo responsável por idealizar e projetar as coleções de Athleisure, garantindo que a marca esteja na vanguarda das tendências mundiais de moda e comportamento. Sua missão é conceber o direcionamento estético e o conceito das coleções, transformando inspirações globais em produtos que equilibram perfeitamente o desejo de moda lifestyle com a funcionalidade esportiva. Ele atua como o líder criativo que define o tom da marca, assegurando inovação constante e relevância comercial.

Responsabilidades Principais:
Criação e Conceituação de Coleção: Liderar o desenvolvimento de temas, cartelas de cores e formas, criando o DNA visual das coleções de cada entrada sazonal. Pesquisa de Tendências Mundiais: Realizar pesquisas contínuas sobre o mercado de Athleisure global, antecipando movimentos de moda, novos shapes e comportamentos de consumo. Direcionamento Criativo: Propor os conceitos e ideias que servirão de base para o desenvolvimento técnico, garantindo que a essência criativa seja o ponto de partida de cada peça. Interface de Viabilidade Criativa: Trabalhar em sinergia com o Especialista de Design para garantir que a visão estética original seja traduzida fielmente em produtos técnicos viáveis. Curadoria de Materiais e Estilo: Selecionar matérias-primas e acabamentos que reforcem o posicionamento de moda tecnológica e lifestyle da marca.
Guardião do Lifestyle da Marca: Zelar pela consistência estética e pela evolução da imagem da marca, garantindo que o produto final seja uma referência de estilo no mercado.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada como Estilista Criativo, com histórico comprovado no desenvolvimento de coleções de moda, preferencialmente no nicho Sportswear ou Athleisure. Domínio Estético e Repertório: Profundo conhecimento de história da moda, tendências contemporâneas e capacidade de traduzir conceitos abstratos em coleções comerciais. Visão de Mercado Global: Habilidade para adaptar tendências internacionais para o contexto do varejo nacional, mantendo o DNA da marca. Habilidades Criativas: Domínio de ferramentas de ilustração e desenho de moda, com olhar apurado para proporções, cores e composições.
Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.

Vivência em viagens de pesquisa internacional e participação em feiras globais do setor têxtil e de moda.
Experiência em marcas de moda lifestyle com alto nível de valor agregado e identidade autoral.

Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de laboratório e campo;
Planejar, executar e validar ensaios de solos, concreto e asfalto;

Acompanhar resultados, elaborar relatórios e apoiar a engenharia;
Zelar pela calibração, conservação dos equipamentos e organização do laboratório. Formação técnica ou superior em áreas correlatas;

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças. I. A Missão da Posição
O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.
II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados. Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance. Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce. Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio. Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios. Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes. Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores. Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais
Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.

title: Coordenador (a) planejamento e controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.
Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.
Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .
Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.
Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.
Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Coordenar as atividades de planejamento regulatório, garantindo a gestão estratégica dos contratos, a análise de impactos regulatórios e a interface com stakeholders internos e externos, com foco na sustentabilidade econômico-financeira da operação.

Apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas a reequilíbrios contratuais, investimentos e pleitos.
Garantir governança, qualidade técnica e consistência das informações apresentadas.
Atuar fortemente na gestão com visão integrada do contrato.
Requisitos
Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência sólida em planejamento regulatório, concessões, PPPs ou gestão de contratos complexos.
Forte domínio de análises econômico-financeiras e visão estratégica.
Capacidade de liderança, coordenação e desenvolvimento de equipe.
Perfil analítico, com boa comunicação e capacidade de articulação com múltiplos stakeholders.

Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);

Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.
Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.
