title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

description:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. About the job:
The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.
Audit & Compliance: Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC). Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.

Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager. Documentation & Records:
Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function. Training & Communication:
Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.
Work Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.
Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.
Educational:
High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.
Technical Skills:
Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.
Soft Skills:
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.
Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.

title: Senior full stack ai engineer
description:
About Us
Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli,XILOset out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.
Initially launched as a vertical Saa S solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.The Role
You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

AI & Backend Architecture:Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our coreChrome Extensionproduct. This is a critical interface for our users.
Service Tuning:Interface with and optimize existing microservices written inNode.js. You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
Frontend Maintenance:implement UI/UX features usingAngular. While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.

Seniority:5+ years of commercial software development experience.
Python Mastery:Deep experience with Python for backend development.
AI/Agent Experience:proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
Note:Specific framework knowledge (Lang Chain, Crew AI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
Node.js Proficiency:Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.Nice to Have
Experience withLang ChainorCrew AI.
Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
Previous experience in theInsur Techor Fintech sectors.
Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
Familiarity withAngular.Why Join Us?
Impact:Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
Cutting Edge Tech:We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
Remote Culture:Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

Emitir relatórios operacionais e apoiar a gestão nas rotinas do PCPRequisitos obrigatórios
Conhecimento em rotinas de Planejamento, Programação e Controle da Produção (PCP)
Boa organização e atenção a prazos
Excel avançado para controle e acompanhamento de dados
Noções de controle de estoque e logísticaRequisitos desejáveis
Experiência com sistemas ERP (Totvs, Protheus, SAP ou similares)
Vivência em ambientes industriais
Noções de indicadores de produção (OEE, produtividade, eficiência)
Leitura básica de ordens de fabricação e documentos técnicosCompetências comportamentais
Organização e atenção aos detalhes
Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe
Boa comunicação com áreas operacionaisFormação
Mínimo:Ensino Técnico em Administração, Logística, Produção Industrial ou áreas correlatas
Desejável:Ensino Superior em Engenharia de Produção, Gestão da Produção Industrial ou áreas afinsExperiência
Mínima:1 ano em rotinas de PCP, produção ou controle de estoque

title: Product owner
description:

title: Quality analyst
description:
About us:DTX Aerospaceis a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.About the job:The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.Audit & Compliance:
Conduct scheduled and unscheduledinternal auditsin accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.g., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
Assist in preparing for and supportingexternal audits(regulatory and customer).
Inspection Oversight:
Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Non-Conformance Management:
Identify and documentnon-conformances (NCRs)during audits or inspections.
Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.
Documentation & Records:
Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.
Training & Communication:
Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.Work Experience:
Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.
Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.Educational:
High school diploma or GED required; associate or bachelor's degree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.
Technical Skills:
Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.Soft Skills:
Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
Effective written and verbal communication.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.
Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

title: Exchange administrator
description:

Proven experience with Exchange 2016, including maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting.

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.

title: Strategic executive assistant to the ceo
description:
The VisionAt AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a "thinking partner" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.Who We’re Looking ForThe Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's "20% focus" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.
You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who "just gets it" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.Why You Should Join UsAI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.Role ResponsibilitiesThe 20% That Drives 80% of Success
Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero "emotional leakage".
Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.
The Remaining 80%
Hub Spot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.Skills & Attributes We're Looking ForMethodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, Hub Spot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
Coachability : You believe feedback is the "breakfast of champions" and iterate quickly based on guidance.Our ValuesCreate remarkable experiences– Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
Always be growing– Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
Deliver results– Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
Do the right thing– Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
Practice what we teach– Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.
Compensation & LocationCompensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).Application & Selection ProcessTO APPLY:
Send your Resume(PDF titled "Lastname. Firstname. EA.pdf") to (Operations+ ).
Record a short demo video(2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights:Process Optimization Proposal:Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.

title: Senior product experience designer (remote) - b2b healthtech saas
description:
Ongoing contract role ·10 hours per week· Remote (Brazil Based)
Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
International team across Brazil and North America
5+ years of designing Saa S web applications(required)
Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
Fluent English required - written and spokenAbout the Role
We’re looking for aSenior Product Experience Designerto help shape the user experience of a Saa S web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.This role is intentionally scoped at10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused onsenior-level product experience design- the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.This role is well suited to someone who:
enjoys focused, high-impact work,
may already have other professional commitments,
and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to designend-to-end product experiences— from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.About Optive
We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.Our team works across two closely related platforms:
Optive- a patient engagement and care platform
Optimal DX- an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners todayYou’ll contribute experience design work acrossboth platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.What You'll Do
Designend-to-end user journeysfor complex Saa S web applications
Translate product goals intoclear workflows, flows, and wireframes
Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
Communicate clearly with an international team inEnglish , both written and spokenWhy this Role Might be a Fit
Have5+ years of experiencedesigning customer-facing Saa S products or complex web applications
Have worked on products that real customers use in production
Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
Can overlap some working hours with PST
Communicate fluently in EnglishPreferred Background
While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:
Designedcomplex Saa S or web applicationsused in production
Owned or heavily influencedend-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2 B, or data-heavy products)
Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impactIf your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.Proof Matters
We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:
Screenshots of shipped Saa S products
Annotated flows or wireframes
Case studies explaining experience design decisions
Clear examples of problems you personally solvedWe understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who canpoint to real experience design workand talk concretely about the decisions behind it.How to Apply
Apply via Linked In.Please include:
A short note about your experience designing Saa S or web applications
Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience

title: Electrical bim lead
description:

title: Document controller
description:
Company Brief :At Cyient, we are driven by a singular purpose—to improve the daily lives of people around the world. Whether it’s enabling a quieter flight, a safer train journey, a more affordable medical device, or a faster internet connection, our unwavering focus is on creating meaningful impact through innovation.

The Document Controller will manage and maintain project documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational and industry standards. This role supports engineering and project management teams by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding technical and commercial documents across the project lifecycle.Job Responsibilities:Establish and maintain document control systems (EDMS/DMS) for projects and operations.

Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
3–5 years of experience in document control/records management in Oil & Gas/Offshore Drilling/EPC/EPCm industries.
Hands-on with EDMS/DMS platforms (ACONEX, Oracle UNIFIER, Share Point Online, e Room, Meridian). Experience with Open Text’ is preferred.
Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and collaboration tools (Teams).
Familiarity with engineering documentation (e.g., P&IDs, PFLOW, vendor drawings, data books, specifications).
Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines.

title: Swe manager - mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?
A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.
Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.
Nossa cultura:
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
⚡ Own It:Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride:Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit:Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play:Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason:O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.Como é ser uma pessoa Engineering Manager:
Ser Engineering Manager na Stone significa liderar equipes de engenharia de software, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a resultados. É esperado que você atue como facilitador, garantindo que os times tenham clareza de propósito e os recursos necessários para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. Além disso, você será responsável por alinhar as metas técnicas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa, promovendo o crescimento profissional dos membros da equipe e fomentando uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo. Além de:Liderar e desenvolver times de engenharia, com foco em alta performance e crescimento individual.
Buscar conhecimento sobre os planos estratégicos e operacionais da empresa, propagando e conectando direcionamento técnico alinhado a estrategia;
Garantir a entrega de soluções técnicas alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio, em parceria com PMs, Designers e outras lideranças.
Facilitar a comunicação entre times técnicos e stakeholders, garantindo transparência e alinhamento.
Promover um ambiente de colaboração, segurança psicológica e feedback constante.
Garantir construção de estratégias técnicas dos domínios do time, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia (Clean Code, TDD, CI/CD, Dev Sec Ops).

Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Psicólogo - Supervisor ABA
description:
MISSÃO

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. Atua também como facilitador da coordenação do cuidado e da integração com famílias, escolas e equipes interdisciplinares.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/contato inicial com o aprendiz, família, escola e equipe multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial de famílias e indivíduos neuro divergentes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.
  • Coordenar, orientar e treinar a equipe de intervenção, os familiares, cuidadores e outras pessoas significativas, a implementar os programas e procedimentos delineados, na presença e na ausência do aprendiz.
  • Realizar comunicação e treinamento, quando necessário, da equipe de coordenação de cuidado.

ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO

  • Ensino superior em psicologia, com carteira do conselho ativa.
  • Pós graduação completa em análise do comportamento aplicada ao TEA.
  • Ter obtido título de mestre ou doutor em análise do comportamento ou áreas associadas ao desenvolvimento atípico (diferencial).
  • Certificação em procedimento de gerenciamento de crises agressivas (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.
